name: institutes-platform
description: Map-first educational marketplace & institute management platform (NestJS + Next.js + PostGIS)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@institutes/api & npm run dev --workspace=@institutes/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@institutes/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@institutes/api && npm run build --workspace=@institutes/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@institutes/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@institutes/api && npm run lint --workspace=@institutes/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@institutes/api
